# `scope_set_location`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set the observing site location on the connected mount.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x7b950, ScopeAM5::SetSiteLatLong (64-bit build) |

Passes the supplied latitude and longitude to the mount location setter when the mount supports it and updates local geographic caches or configuration. Success means the call returned, not that the mount accepted the values. Longitude is decimal degrees, positive east (INFERRED, strong: the mount driver negates it for the mount's west-positive site command). Parameter forms: object or positional array; both members required. Via the imager command port (4700) the request reaches this handler only as a forwarded unknown method; see the control service for the relay. Mount serial (firmware 9.31, READ): :St then :Sg.

Side effects: Changes the mount site location and local geographic cache/configuration.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"scope_set_location"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|array | yes | - | Object with latitude and longitude, or the positional array [latitude, longitude]. Both are required; integer or real accepted (reals are widened from 32-bit float). The handler applies no range, clamp or default; geographic validity is left to the mount driver, which negates the longitude for the mount's west-positive site command. [READ] |
| `params.latitude` | number | yes | - | Site latitude in degrees (INFERRED sign convention: north positive). [INFERRED] |
| `params.longitude` | number | yes | - | Site longitude in decimal degrees, positive east (INFERRED, strong; the driver negates it for the mount's west-positive site command). Wrap not established. [READ (negation); INFERRED (east-positive convention)] |

| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |

| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |

## Example

Request, request - Example request (values invented):

```json
{"id":42,"method":"scope_set_location","params":[10,20]}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_set_location","result":0,"code":0,"id":42}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_set_location","error":"expected float param","code":108,"id":43}
```
